cond_0001.intro: Represent Dimensional Management in the Model Centric (concurrent) engineering design efforts beginning with initial model development through final release.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Dimensional Management of a design effort will require working with CAD designers, project design engineers and manufacturing engineers to perform the following activities:
Evaluate the model objectives and provide initial Datum recommendations. Datum revision recommendations will also be provided during the design development maturity process.
Continuous involvement in design reviews to ensure that the Dimensional Management objectives are maintained to minimize redesign thru production level drawing / model releases.
Ensure design variation is managed thru the engineering design development process to help ensure parts fit and operate properly the first time, at assembly.
Conduct manual tolerance evaluations of subsystem and component designs to ensure design functionality and design variation are considered in design development to ensure vehicle end item operational requirements are met. (VisVSA experience or equivalent a plus)
Direct and monitor the development of the Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing callouts of the models and drawings to ensure compliance with ASME Y14.5M-2009.
Work with manufacturing during the development of the dimensional controls to ensure the objectives of engineering functionality and manufacturing requirements are balanced.
Provide accurate interpretation and application of ASME Y14.5-2009 GD&T standards and dimensional analysis requirements with other design / engineering groups.
Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum of 5 years of related work experience.
High proficiency in interpretation and application of ASME Y14.5M-2009.
Firm understanding of mechanical engineering practices as they relate to product development activities in military land vehicle designs.
Ability to work with 2D drawings as well as in a 3D CAD environment.
Working knowledge of manufacturing fabrication, processes and capabilities.
Working knowledge of Design for Manufacturing and Assembly practices.
Microsoft Office Software proficient.
This position requires eligibility to obtain a [Location masked] security clearance. (Non-[Location masked] Citizens may not be eligible to obtain a security clearance) NO SPONSORSHIP OFFERED.
Strong written and oral communication skills.
Able to work overtime when required.
Limited travel may be required.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor of Science in an engineering discipline.
CAD software experience (Creo, NX).
Teamcenter experience.
Working knowledge of tooling / functional gaging practices.
Knowledge of quality inspection techniques and ability to interpret CMM data.
Knowledge of machine design engineering practices.
Knowledge of material applications.

cond_0146.intro: We are looking for a Dimensional Analysis Engineer to join our team.
cond_0146.responsibilities:
Represent Dimensional Management in the Model Centric (concurrent) engineering design efforts beginning with initial model development through final release.
Dimensional Management of a design effort will require working with CAD designers, project design engineers and manufacturing engineers to perform the following activities:
Evaluate the model objectives and provide initial Datum recommendations. Datum revision recommendations will also be provided during the design development maturity process.
Continuous involvement in design reviews to ensure that the Dimensional Management objectives are maintained to minimize redesign thru production level drawing / model releases.
Ensure design variation is managed thru the engineering design development process to help ensure parts fit and operate properly the first time, at assembly.
Conduct manual tolerance evaluations of subsystem and component designs to ensure design functionality and design variation are considered in design development to ensure vehicle end item operational requirements are met. (VisVSA experience or equivalent a plus)
Direct and monitor the development of the Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing callouts of the models and drawings to ensure compliance with ASME Y14.5M-2009.
Work with manufacturing during the development of the dimensional controls to ensure the objectives of engineering functionality and manufacturing requirements are balanced.
Provide accurate interpretation and application of ASME Y14.5-2009 GD&T standards and dimensional analysis requirements with other design / engineering groups.
Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0146.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor of Science in an engineering discipline required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 5 years of demonstrated expertise in dimensional management or related engineering work.
Deep knowledge of interpretation and application of ASME Y14.5M-2009.
Strong command of mechanical engineering practices as they relate to product development in military land vehicle designs.
Proven ability to work with 2D drawings and strong proficiency in a 3D CAD environment.
Advanced knowledge of manufacturing fabrication, processes, and capabilities.
Advanced knowledge of Design for Manufacturing and Assembly practices.
Exceptional written and oral communication skills.
This position requires eligibility to obtain a [Location masked] security clearance. (Non-[Location masked] Citizens may not be eligible to obtain a security clearance) NO SPONSORSHIP OFFERED.

Expertise in CAD software (Creo, NX).
Proficiency in Teamcenter.
Advanced knowledge of tooling and functional gaging practices.
Solid understanding of quality inspection techniques and ability to interpret CMM data.
Advanced knowledge of machine design engineering practices.
Solid understanding of material applications.
Strong command of Microsoft Office Software.
Ability to work overtime when required.
Willingness to work in office, lab, prototype, and test site environments.
Limited travel may be required.

cond_0270.intro: We are looking for a Dimensional Analysis Engineer to join our team, supporting Model Centric (concurrent) engineering design efforts from initial model development through final release.
cond_0270.responsibilities:
Coordinate with CAD designers, project design engineers, and manufacturing engineers to support Dimensional Management throughout the engineering design process.
Work with the design team to evaluate model objectives and provide initial Datum recommendations. Share updated Datum revision recommendations as the design matures.
Participate continuously in design reviews to help ensure Dimensional Management objectives are maintained and minimize redesign through production-level drawing and model releases.
Collaborate with the engineering team to manage design variation throughout the development process, helping to ensure parts fit and operate properly at assembly.
Conduct manual tolerance evaluations of subsystem and component designs in coordination with design and engineering groups to ensure functionality and variation are considered and vehicle end item operational requirements are met. (VisVSA experience or equivalent a plus)
Work alongside designers to support the development of Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing callouts on models and drawings, ensuring compliance with ASME Y14.5M-2009.
Coordinate with manufacturing during development of dimensional controls to help balance engineering functionality and manufacturing requirements.
Share accurate interpretation and application of ASME Y14.5-2009 GD&T standards and dimensional analysis requirements with other design and engineering groups.
Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0270.requirements:
Bachelors of Science in an engineering discipline preferred.
Minimum of 5 years of related work experience.
High proficiency in interpretation and application of ASME Y 14.5M-2009.
Firm understanding of mechanical engineering practices as they relate to product development activities in military land vehicle designs.
Ability to work with 2D drawings as well as in a 3D CAD environment as we transition into engineering digital transformation.
CAD software experience (Creo, NX) desired.
Teamcenter experience desired.
Working knowledge of manufacturing fabrication, processes and capabilities.
Working knowledge of Design for Manufacturing and Assembly practices.
Working knowledge of tooling / functional gaging practices.
Knowledge of quality inspection techniques and ability to interpret CMM data.
Knowledge of machine design engineering practices.
Knowledge of material applications.
Microsoft Office Software proficient.

Strong written and oral communication skills.

cond_0365.intro: We are looking for a Dimensional Analysis Engineer to join our team. This role involves representing Dimensional Management in Model Centric (concurrent) engineering design efforts, from initial model development through final release. Most people become stronger in this kind of dimensional and tolerance analysis work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0365.responsibilities:
Represent Dimensional Management in the Model Centric (concurrent) engineering design efforts beginning with initial model development through final release.
Dimensional Management of a design effort will require working with CAD designers, project design engineers and manufacturing engineers to perform the following activities:
Evaluate the model objectives and provide initial Datum recommendations. Datum revision recommendations will also be provided during the design development maturity process.
Continuous involvement in design reviews to ensure that the Dimensional Management objectives are maintained to minimize redesign thru production level drawing / model releases.
Ensure design variation is managed thru the engineering design development process to help ensure parts fit and operate properly the first time, at assembly.
Conduct manual tolerance evaluations of subsystem and component designs to ensure design functionality and design variation are considered in design development to ensure vehicle end item operational requirements are met. (VisVSA experience or equivalent a plus)
Direct and monitor the development of the Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing callouts of the models and drawings to ensure compliance with ASME Y14.5M-2009.
Work with manufacturing during the development of the dimensional controls to ensure the objectives of engineering functionality and manufacturing requirements are balanced.
Provide accurate interpretation and application of ASME Y14.5-2009 GD&T standards and dimensional analysis requirements with other design / engineering groups.
Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0365.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum of 5 years of related work experience.
High proficiency in interpretation and application of ASME Y14.5M-2009.
Firm understanding of mechanical engineering practices as they relate to product development activities in military land vehicle designs.
Ability to work with 2D drawings as well as in a 3D CAD environment.
Working knowledge of manufacturing fabrication, processes and capabilities.
Working knowledge of Design for Manufacturing and Assembly practices.
Microsoft Office Software proficient.
This position requires eligibility to obtain a [Location masked] security clearance. (Non-[Location masked] Citizens may not be eligible to obtain a security clearance) NO SPONSORSHIP OFFERED.
Strong written and oral communication skills.
Able to work overtime when required.
Limited travel may be required.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor of Science in an engineering discipline.
CAD software experience (Creo, NX).
Teamcenter experience.
Working knowledge of tooling / functional gaging practices.
Knowledge of quality inspection techniques and ability to interpret CMM data.
Knowledge of machine design engineering practices.
Knowledge of material applications.

cond_0462.intro: We are looking for a Dimensional Analysis Engineer to join our team.
cond_0462.responsibilities:

Dimensional Management of a design effort will require working with CAD designers, project design engineers and manufacturing engineers to perform the following activities:

cond_0482.intro: We are looking for a Dimensional Analysis Engineer to join our team at [Company name masked]. The role involves representing Dimensional Management in Model Centric concurrent engineering design efforts, from initial model development through final release. People usually grow into this kind of dimensional analysis work over time as they build experience with tolerance evaluation, GD&T standards, and design development processes.
cond_0482.responsibilities:
Represent Dimensional Management in the Model Centric (concurrent) engineering design efforts beginning with initial model development through final release.
Dimensional Management of a design effort will require working with CAD designers, project design engineers and manufacturing engineers to perform the following activities:
Evaluate the model objectives and provide initial Datum recommendations. Datum revision recommendations will also be provided during the design development maturity process.
Continuous involvement in design reviews to ensure that the Dimensional Management objectives are maintained to minimize redesign thru production level drawing / model releases.
Ensure design variation is managed thru the engineering design development process to help ensure parts fit and operate properly the first time, at assembly.
Conduct manual tolerance evaluations of subsystem and component designs to ensure design functionality and design variation are considered in design development to ensure vehicle end item operational requirements are met. (VisVSA experience or equivalent a plus)
Direct and monitor the development of the Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing callouts of the models and drawings to ensure compliance with ASME Y14.5M-2009.
Work with manufacturing during the development of the dimensional controls to ensure the objectives of engineering functionality and manufacturing requirements are balanced.
Provide accurate interpretation and application of ASME Y14.5-2009 GD&T standards and dimensional analysis requirements with other design / engineering groups.
Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0482.requirements:
Bachelors of Science in an engineering discipline preferred.
Minimum of 5 years of related work experience.
High proficiency in interpretation and application of ASME Y 14.5M-2009.
Have a firm understanding of mechanical engineering practices as they relate to product development activities in military land vehicle designs.
Have the ability to work with 2D drawings as well as ability to work in a 3D CAD environment as we transition into engineering digital transformation.
CAD software experience (Creo, NX) desired.
Teamcenter experience desired.
Working knowledge of manufacturing fabrication, processes and capabilities.
Working knowledge of Design for Manufacturing and Assembly practices.
Working knowledge of tooling / functional gaging practices.
Knowledge of quality inspection techniques and ability to interpret CMM data.
Knowledge of machine design engineering practices.
Knowledge of material applications.
Microsoft Office Software proficient.
This position requires eligibility to obtain a [Location masked] security clearance. (Non-[Location masked] Citizens may not be eligible to obtain a security clearance) NO SPONSORSHIP OFFERED.
The candidate will need to have strong written and oral communication skills.
Able to work overtime when required.
Limited travel may be required.

Represent Dimensional Management in the Model Centric (concurrent) engineering design efforts beginning with initial model development through final release.
Dimensional Management of a design effort will require working with CAD designers, project design engineers and manufacturing engineers to perform the following activities:
Evaluate the model objectives and provide initial Datum recommendations. Datum revision recommendations will also be provided during the design development maturity process.
Continuous involvement in design reviews to ensure that the Dimensional Management objectives are maintained to minimize redesign thru production level drawing / model releases.
Ensure design variation is managed thru the engineering design development process to help ensure parts fit and operate properly the first time, at assembly.
Conduct manual tolerance evaluations of subsystem and component designs to ensure design functionality and design variation are considered in design development to ensure vehicle end item operational requirements are met. (VisVSA experience or equivalent a plus)
Direct and monitor the development of the Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing callouts of the models and drawings to ensure compliance with ASME Y14.5M-2009.
Work with manufacturing during the development of the dimensional controls to ensure the objectives of engineering functionality and manufacturing requirements are balanced.
Provide accurate interpretation and application of ASME Y14.5-2009 GD&T standards and dimensional analysis requirements with other design / engineering groups.
Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0524.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor of Science in an engineering discipline required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 5 years of demonstrated expertise in dimensional management or related engineering work.
Deep knowledge of interpretation and application of ASME Y14.5M-2009.
Strong command of mechanical engineering practices as they relate to product development in military land vehicle designs.
Proven ability to work with 2D drawings and strong proficiency in a 3D CAD environment.
Advanced knowledge of manufacturing fabrication, processes, and capabilities.
Advanced knowledge of Design for Manufacturing and Assembly practices.
Exceptional written and oral communication skills.
This position requires eligibility to obtain a [Location masked] security clearance. (Non-[Location masked] Citizens may not be eligible to obtain a security clearance) NO SPONSORSHIP OFFERED.
Preferred Requirements
Expertise in CAD software (Creo, NX).
Proficiency in Teamcenter.
Advanced knowledge of tooling and functional gaging practices.
Solid understanding of quality inspection techniques and ability to interpret CMM data.
Advanced knowledge of machine design engineering practices.
Solid understanding of material applications.
Strong command of Microsoft Office Software.
Ability to work overtime when required.
Willingness to work in office, lab, prototype, and test site environments.
Limited travel may be required.
cond_0524.workplace_support: We aim to support employees across different life and career stages through development resources, workplace flexibility, and inclusive benefits that make it easier to grow, contribute, and stay well.

People usually grow into this kind of dimensional analysis work over time as they build experience with tolerance evaluation, GD&T standards, and design development processes.
cond_0536.responsibilities:
Represent Dimensional Management in the Model Centric (concurrent) engineering design efforts beginning with initial model development through final release.
Dimensional Management of a design effort will require working with CAD designers, project design engineers and manufacturing engineers to perform the following activities:
Evaluate the model objectives and provide initial Datum recommendations. Datum revision recommendations will also be provided during the design development maturity process.
Continuous involvement in design reviews to ensure that the Dimensional Management objectives are maintained to minimize redesign thru production level drawing / model releases.
Ensure design variation is managed thru the engineering design development process to help ensure parts fit and operate properly the first time, at assembly.
Conduct manual tolerance evaluations of subsystem and component designs to ensure design functionality and design variation are considered in design development to ensure vehicle end item operational requirements are met. (VisVSA experience or equivalent a plus)
Direct and monitor the development of the Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing callouts of the models and drawings to ensure compliance with ASME Y14.5M-2009.
Work with manufacturing during the development of the dimensional controls to ensure the objectives of engineering functionality and manufacturing requirements are balanced.
Provide accurate interpretation and application of ASME Y14.5-2009 GD&T standards and dimensional analysis requirements with other design / engineering groups.
Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0536.requirements:
Bachelors of Science in an engineering discipline preferred.
Minimum of 5 years of related work experience.
High proficiency in interpretation and application of ASME Y 14.5M-2009.
Have a firm understanding of mechanical engineering practices as they relate to product development activities in military land vehicle designs.
Have the ability to work with 2D drawings as well as ability to work in a 3D CAD environment as we transition into engineering digital transformation.
CAD software experience (Creo, NX) desired.
Teamcenter experience desired.
Working knowledge of manufacturing fabrication, processes and capabilities.
Working knowledge of Design for Manufacturing and Assembly practices.
Working knowledge of tooling / functional gaging practices.
Knowledge of quality inspection techniques and ability to interpret CMM data.
Knowledge of machine design engineering practices.
Knowledge of material applications.
Microsoft Office Software proficient.
This position requires eligibility to obtain a [Location masked] security clearance. (Non-[Location masked] Citizens may not be eligible to obtain a security clearance) NO SPONSORSHIP OFFERED.
The candidate will need to have strong written and oral communication skills.
Able to work overtime when required.
Limited travel may be required.
cond_0536.workplace_support: We aim to support employees across different life and career stages through development resources, workplace flexibility, and inclusive benefits that make it easier to grow, contribute, and stay well.

The role involves representing Dimensional Management in Model Centric (concurrent) engineering design efforts, from initial model development through final release. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of dimensional variation and how it flows through a design.
cond_0625.responsibilities:
Represent Dimensional Management in the Model Centric (concurrent) engineering design efforts beginning with initial model development through final release.
Dimensional Management of a design effort will require working with CAD designers, project design engineers and manufacturing engineers to perform the following activities:
Evaluate the model objectives and provide initial Datum recommendations. Datum revision recommendations will also be provided during the design development maturity process.
Continuous involvement in design reviews to ensure that the Dimensional Management objectives are maintained to minimize redesign thru production level drawing / model releases.
Ensure design variation is managed thru the engineering design development process to help ensure parts fit and operate properly the first time, at assembly.
Conduct manual tolerance evaluations of subsystem and component designs to ensure design functionality and design variation are considered in design development to ensure vehicle end item operational requirements are met. (VisVSA experience or equivalent a plus)
Direct and monitor the development of the Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing callouts of the models and drawings to ensure compliance with ASME Y14.5M-2009.
Work with manufacturing during the development of the dimensional controls to ensure the objectives of engineering functionality and manufacturing requirements are balanced.
Provide accurate interpretation and application of ASME Y14.5-2009 GD&T standards and dimensional analysis requirements with other design / engineering groups.
Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0625.requirements:
Bachelors of Science in an engineering discipline preferred.
Minimum of 5 years of related work experience.
High proficiency in interpretation and application of ASME Y 14.5M-2009.
Have a firm understanding of mechanical engineering practices as they relate to product development activities in military land vehicle designs.
Have the ability to work with 2D drawings as well as ability to work in a 3D CAD environment as we transition into engineering digital transformation.
CAD software experience (Creo, NX) desired.
Teamcenter experience desired.
Working knowledge of manufacturing fabrication, processes and capabilities.
Working knowledge of Design for Manufacturing and Assembly practices.
Working knowledge of tooling / functional gaging practices.
Knowledge of quality inspection techniques and ability to interpret CMM data.
Knowledge of machine design engineering practices.
Knowledge of material applications.
Microsoft Office Software proficient.
This position requires eligibility to obtain a security clearance. (Non-citizens may not be eligible to obtain a security clearance) NO SPONSORSHIP OFFERED.
Must be willing to work in an office, lab, proto-type and test site environments.
Be a self-starter.
The candidate will need to have strong written and oral communication skills.
Able to work overtime when required.
Limited travel may be required.
cond_0625.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
